lessons_used: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.

No clear effect: Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders/flows, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, archetype selector flows, and hatching progress bars.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility reassurance copy, and desktop dock placement guidance banners.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, and all changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Action Video Card
candidates.change: Redesign the final home intro screen with a centered video walkthrough card showcasing desktop interaction shortcuts, hiding, and talking controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Watch this quick 10-second guide to learn how to drag, interact, mute, or summon your pet anywhere on your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen inside onboarding complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step redesigns have previously reduced conversion by 3.1%.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Interactive Badge Assistant
candidates.change: Introduce a real-time status badge and helper prompt on the photo upload view to guide custom photo uploads prior to generation.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or generates unexpected results for several users, contributing to a high mean drop-off time (1017s) during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload High-Clarity Custom Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Ensure lighting is bright and your pet's full face is visible for optimal 3D desktop rendering.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive photo quality status badge to photo upload is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Photo quality assistants strongly improve adoption completion (+9.3%).

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated spawn verification step right after waiting that confirms the desktop pet asset has rendered on screen before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support received multiple high-priority bug reports stating pets fail to appear on the desktop or the app stalls before completion.

new_desktop_spawn_check.headline: Verifying Desktop Spawn
new_desktop_spawn_check.body: We are making sure your pet safely landed on your desktop bar. Click proceed once you see your friend move.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps passes.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra verification screens creates friction in home step.

candidates.title: Pre-Finish Sign-In Reorder Flow
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur right before the final home intro screen after waiting finishes.
candidates.why: Users face high hesitation at sign-in early in the flow (mean 567s). Asking for account creation right before final desktop release maintains early adoption momentum.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after waiting is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reorders show mild lift (+2.0%), though earlier expectations were over-optimistic.

candidates.title: Simplified Express Companion Directives
candidates.change: Update choose path text to emphasize instantaneous adoption choices with minimal setup time.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has an extremely long mean duration (514s), indicating users deliberate far too long on early path decisions.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Express Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Pick how you'd like to create your pet today. You can always change settings or add pets later.
choose_path.hint: Preset pets launch instantly, while custom pets generate from your photos.

guard.reason: Updated copy preserves the core job of offering both adoption and custom pet paths.

candidates.score_note: Path choice copy helper callouts performed poorly (-2.8%).

candidates.title: Audio-Visual Generation Timer Callout
candidates.change: Add an explicit live countdown timer component and completion sound preview to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing anxiety and app abandonment during pet generation.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your pet is currently being rendered and trained. Keep this window open or minimized.

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[0]': timer text must read like 'About 4 min left' (at most 30 min)

candidates.title: Pet Adoption Seal Reward Visual
candidates.change: Add an official adoption seal mascot badge component to the adoption certificate screen to build excitement before final generation.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 75.3% with a long mean duration (1017s); reinforcing official ownership encourages users to complete creation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet adoption is officially registered! Your companion is ready to be generated.

guard.reason: Adding an official adoption seal badge preserves the adoption certificate job.

candidates.score_note: Adding reward visuals on adoption certificate provides a modest boost.

candidates.title: Pet Persistence Account Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint banner on sign-in clarifying that signing into the correct account prevents pet data loss across app launches.
candidates.why: Support received 8 reports regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in, causing user friction and confusion.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Link your account to save your companion's identity, visual traits, and memory cloud securely.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet stays saved even if you switch devices or reboot.

guard.reason: Adding account persistence hint text on sign-in is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints directly address user support complaints with minimal implementation effort.

candidates.title: Audio Notification Generation Complete Switch
candidates.change: Add a desktop system notification trigger switch on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during long renders.
candidates.why: Mean wait time during generation is 2336s; letting users enable background completion alerts prevents app abandonment.

waiting.headline: Pet Generation in Progress
waiting.body: Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you the moment your pet is ready to spawn.

components.text: Notification enabled: Sound alert will play on completion

guard.reason: Adding a completion notification toggle on the waiting screen complies with onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Notification switches during long waits yield reliable improvement (+3.4%).

candidates.title: Split View Story Intro Showcase
candidates.change: Change the initial story intro layout to a split view highlighting companion preview animations alongside welcome text.
candidates.why: Initial choose_path step drop-off (18%) and long completion times indicate users need immediate visual engagement upon launching onboarding.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World
story.body: Meet lightweight AI companions that live, react, and assist right on your desktop overlay.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story intro layout to split view preserves the story screen's job.

candidates.score_note: Split-view path intro screens are proven high-confidence winners.

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, and custom pet style selector views.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock placement guidance banners, and desktop control action video cards.

No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, and archetype selector flows.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split view story intros, and all tests showing no clear effect or negative performance.
